item.text: {"explanation":"Retain one record per key, selecting the maximum tuple (version, deletion flag, actor, value) with explicit Unicode code-point comparison. The retained record determines whether a key is visible or a tombstone. Tombstone keys are sorted by code point order, and output maps safely preserve arbitrary string keys.","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){const s=Array.isArray(state)?state:[],cp=(a,b)=>{const x=Array.from(a),y=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(x.length,y.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(x[i]!==y[i])return x[i]<y[i]?-1:1;return x.length-y.length},gt=(a,b)=>a[0]!==b[0]?a[0]>b[0]:a[1]!==b[1]?a[1]>b[1]:cp(a[2],b[2])?cp(a[2],b[2])>0:cp(a[3],b[3])>0,r=[event.version,event.deleted?1:0,event.actor,event.value];let i=-1;for(let j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j][0]===event.key){i=j;break}if(i<0)s.push([event.key,r]);else if(gt(r,s[i][1]))s[i][1]=r;const visible={},tombstones=[];for(const e of s)if(e[1][1])tombstones.push(e[0]);else Object.defineProperty(visible,e[0],{value:e[1][3],enumerable:true,configurable:true,writable:true});tombstones.sort(cp);return{state:s,output:{visible:visible,tombstones:tombstones}}}" }
